name: Erase.bg
tagline: Erase.bg is an AI background removal tool that handles both static images and video frames, delivering clean cutouts in seconds. Its batch processing feature and high-resolution output make it practical for e-commerce teams processing large product catalogues. It also offers a background replacement studio where removed backgrounds can be swapped for solid colours, custom images, or gradients.
